source_refs.note: D26 — Predicate-lens independence binds claim-bearing motif evidence.
D31 — BFG measurement split for floor_connectivity.
Project Mission section names predicate-lens-independent methodology.

mission_atoms.statement: Detect named motifs across stratified substrates under predicate-lens-independent methodology.

mission_atoms.expected_drift_constraint: Adding evidence references without dereferenceable paths or private markers is bad drift against this atom.

source_refs.note: D11 — Truth pass before new claims (covered in docs/DOCTRINE.md).
D23 — Dereferenceable evidence or explicit private boundary.
D29 — Runnable evidence or private/narrative downgrade.

mission_atoms.statement: Every claim-bearing artifact carries source-bound evidence with dereferenceable paths or explicit private boundaries.

mission_atoms.expected_drift_constraint: Tuning thresholds after seeing outcomes, or hand-rolling pass bands around typical decoder outputs, is bad drift.

source_refs.note: D12 — Gates are measurements, not counts.

mission_atoms.statement: Pass criteria, gates, and thresholds must come from spec or calibrated null distributions, not engineered around typical outputs.

mission_atoms.expected_drift_constraint: Stub modules anchoring claim-bearing gates, abstract scalars replacing rich state, or shallow tests asserting existence rather than behavior are bad drift.

source_refs.note: D17.5 — Substance floors are spec proxies.

mission_atoms.statement: Worlds, lenses, detectors, and reports must carry substantive logic and substance-bound evidence, not surface contracts alone.

mission_atoms.expected_drift_constraint: Synthetic placeholder content, mock charts, or decorative completeness in any read-only surface is bad drift.

source_refs.note: D22 — Empty rooms beat stocked rooms with mock data.

mission_atoms.statement: Read-only project surfaces and dashboards declare absence honestly rather than mocking missing data.

mission_atoms.expected_drift_constraint: Reports promoting claim-bearing evidence without cross-audit trace or under same-AI extraction-and-detection drift this atom.

source_refs.note: Cross-audit triangle and 'trace is the artifact' canon.
D19, D20 — extraction/detection separation; AI is not evidence.

mission_atoms.statement: Builds are cross-audited (Builder, Architect, Codex, Destroyer lanes) and the trace is the artifact rather than the AI's prose.

mission_atoms.expected_drift_constraint: Public claims pointing at private modules without explicit boundaries, or dashboards rendering against missing artifacts without empty-state, are bad drift.

source_refs.note: D25 — public docs only claim public verification when shipped.
Mission Control Integration section makes the tab a v1 deliverable.
Control Room is the project's reproducible-instrument surface.

mission_atoms.statement: The Attractor Observatory ships as a reproducible research instrument: shipped tests, shipped scripts, shipped reports, and a Mission Control surface against the shipped artifacts.

mission_atoms.expected_drift_constraint: Pooled-corpus claims without Step 0a/0b decomposition drift this atom.
mission_atoms.statement: Analysis on pooled corpora must verify within-stratum balance and run substrate-blocked controls (Step 0a/0b).
